business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Physical Consignment of Shredded Non-Ferrous Scrap

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (special cross-strait investor jurisdiction for the mainland-registered WFOE)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (PRC socialist legal system with civil-law tradition; Taiwan source jurisdiction operates under the Civil Code as a unitary national jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (effective 2013)
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Enhancement of Tax Cooperation (effective 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (revised by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on 8 November 2024, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (State Administration for Market Regulation and People's Bank of China Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 November 2024); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision); Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020); Measures for Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Customer Due Diligence and Customer Risk Rating of Financial Institutions (PBOC Order No. 1 [2016])

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Company Registration Certificate of the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-source documents are governed by the special cross-strait notarization-verification mechanism rather than the Hague Apostille Convention. The original certificate is notarized by a Taiwan district court notary; a notarized duplicate is transmitted through the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) to the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) for verification; the ARATS-verified duplicate is then submitted to SAMR and the target municipal market regulation authority. For documents from a Hague Apostille Contracting State, an Apostille issued by the competent authority replaces consular legalization. For documents from non-member states, Chinese consular legalization is required. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and must never be chained in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Company Registration Record with current directors and shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the Certificate of Good Standing at a Taiwan district court notary; forward the notarized duplicate through SEF to ARATS for verification; submit the ARATS-verified copy to the Chinese competent authority. For a shareholder incorporated in a Hague Apostille Convention jurisdiction, the competent authority of that state must issue an Apostille. For non-member states, the certificate must be consular legalized by the Chinese embassy or consulate. These paths are parallel alternatives, not a combined chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing the establishment of the China WFOE and appointment of its legal representative and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The executed board resolution or notarized power of attorney must be notarized by a Taiwan notary, verified through SEF/ARATS, and then submitted to the PRC registration authority and the target bank. If the corporate shareholder is domiciled in a Hague Convention state, attach an Apostille from the appropriate state authority; if domiciled in a non-member state, complete Chinese consular legalization. No mechanism may be layered or duplicated.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum and Articles of the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) company file or certified corporate records
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: A certified true copy of the articles is notarized by a Taiwan notary, referred through SEF to ARATS for verification, and the verified Chinese-translated copy is submitted to the Shanghai/Tianjin/Shenzhen market supervisory authority together with the WFOE application. Where the shareholder is from a Hague Apostille state, Apostille by the relevant competent authority is the required path; where from a non-member state, consular legalization before the Chinese consular post is required. Only one authentication route applies.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and financial standing report for the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan commercial bank maintaining the shareholder's corporate accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank reference letter must be notarized for the authorized bank officer's signature at a Taiwan notary, with the notarized duplicate verified through SEF/ARATS. The verified letter is then used for the WFOE's PRC bank account pre-opening due diligence and for documentary LC / Swift TT counterparty screening. For a foreign shareholder in a Hague Convention jurisdiction, the bank reference letter must bear an Apostille; for non-member state banks, consular legalization applies. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and must not be combined.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All natural and legal persons owning 25% or more of equity, voting rights, or control through other means must be identified and screened at WFOE formation. Screening must cover the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Consolidated List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, EU restrictive measures, China's list of terrorist organizations and money launderers maintained by PBOC and the Ministry of Public Security, the MOFCOM export control and end-user lists, and SAMR's blacklist of disqualified persons. Current and former politically exposed persons, their family members, close associates, and senior managers of state-owned enterprises require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation, and enhanced monitoring of all documentary LC and Swift TT transactions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Reservation and Registration Platform of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), accessible through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) and provincial integrated market-entity registration portals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A mainland WFOE name must be written in simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier statutory naming structure: administrative division plus distinctive trade name plus industry or business characteristics plus company type, expressed as 有限责任公司 or 有限公司. The English name may appear below the Chinese name on the business license but has no independent legal effect. A pinyin transliteration of the Taiwan investor's brand may serve as the distinctive token, but it cannot contain Latin letters, Arabic numerals, or foreign script, and it must not be confusingly similar to any prior registered enterprise name in the same or related industry under the SAMR name conflict rules.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The statutory name reservation period is 30 days and cannot be extended through the online registry; after expiry the reservation is released and the applicant must file a new name reservation. If the name is rejected, the applicant must first obtain the written refusal notice indicating the conflicting registration or prohibited token. Within 15 days of receipt, the applicant may file administrative reconsideration with the SAMR authority at the next higher level, or may initiate administrative litigation within six months. The reconsideration petition must include the proposed name, a copy of the refusal notice, the WFOE business scope, evidence that the name does not create public confusion, and any prior-use trademark registration for the distinctive token. A hearing may be requested. The higher SAMR authority must render a written decision within 30 days. If the conflict is with a dormant registration, the applicant may simultaneously apply for cancellation of that dormant enterprise for non-operation while pursuing the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a recycled scrap copper wire trading WFOE, a pure virtual office or commercial mailbox is generally rejected by both tax authorities and banks. SAMR may accept a law-firm address for initial registration, but upon tax registration the tax authority will require a physical operating address evidenced by a lease, rent invoices, property tax payment records, on-site signage, and employee presence. Banks will refuse to open corporate accounts for a medium-risk metals-trading entity whose registered office is only a virtual mailbox because AML/CFT site-inspection obligations cannot be satisfied. A virtual office may be used only as a supplementary communication address, never as the principal registered office for VAT ordinary taxpayer registration or documentary LC facilities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: The quantified risk of an unannounced physical inspection is high, estimated above 60% within the first six months after issuance of the business license, particularly in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Suzhou, and Ningbo where metals-trading WFOEs are targeted for tax address verification. Inspection checklist: company name plate at the registered office; original lease and rent payment receipts; employee attendance records; physical office furniture and operational equipment; warehouse or consignment documentation for recycled copper wire; corporate books and VAT records; tax-control equipment; availability of a financial officer; and evidence that the office is not a mere mailbox. If the inspector finds no actual business presence, the WFOE is placed on the abnormal-operations list and its bank settlement functions are suspended.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name reservation and application processing fee (government registry fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / local market supervision authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: China does not impose a state company-registration fee for name reservation; local service fees may apply only if a third-party agency is engaged.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Taiwan shareholder corporate documents notarization and SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification (Certificate of Incorporation, Good Standing, Board Resolution, Articles of Association, Bank Reference Letter)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Taiwan district court notary public, Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF), Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Taiwan notarial tariff, SEF/ARATS processing fees, and market benchmark for cross-strait document verification packages.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official Chinese translation of Taiwan-issued documents and translation certification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed translation service provider with SAMR-registered business scope
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for certified legal translation from Traditional Chinese to Simplified Chinese, approximately USD 0.10 to USD 0.20 per Chinese character with minimum engagement.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chop engraving and licensed official seal registration (company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, contract seal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public Security Bureau (PSB) licensed engraving company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Local PSB tariff for anti-counterfeit seals and market benchmark for full corporate seal set in Shanghai or Shenzhen.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence, WFOE formation drafting, and pre-incorporation AML/UBO compliance advice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External PRC law firm / cross-border corporate attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for WFOE formation involving a medium-risk cross-strait shareholder in the recycled metals sector, generally USD 5,000 to USD 8,500 fixed fee.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office physical lease for the first year and property management deposit (office in industrial park or bonded zone)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rent for an 80 to 100 square metre office in the target city industrial park; amount varies by city, district, and lease terms.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory recycled resources operator filing and industry registration (renewable resources recycling operator record-filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce / local commerce bureau via the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory completion filing is free, but agent and local compliance facilitation fees range from USD 300 to USD 500 in the market.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter and bank account pre-opening compliance consultation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Issuing Taiwan bank and target PRC commercial bank
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank charges for reference letter issuance plus AML compliance consultation fees under prevailing market benchmarks.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan), as consolidated in 2021, Articles 7, 8, 12, 17, 18, 20, 27, 32, 37, 38, 40, 41, 42, 90, 98, 99, 101, 102, 108, 112, 115, 117, 128, 129, 130, 131, 137, 154, 172, 178, 183, 192, 193, 208, 228, 230, 231, 232, 237 and 241; Foreign Investment Act (2018), Articles 3, 7, 8, 9 and 10; Regulations Governing the Approval of Investment by Mainland Chinese Investors, as amended.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs, R.O.C. (Taiwan), including the Taipei and Central Taiwan Company Registration Processing Areas and the One-Stop Administrative Service Portal (onestop.nat.gov.tw).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application Form for a Foreign-Invested Limited Company, together with the approved Foreign Investment Approval Letter and the officially executed and sealed Articles of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No mandatory minimum paid-in capital applies under the Companies Act for a limited company; however, the Investment Commission will assess whether the declared capital is adequate for the proposed cross-border scrap trading and warehousing business. Capital must be remitted into a Taiwan foreign-currency deposit account or NT account, settled through an authorized foreign-exchange bank, and verified by a licensed CPA. No general blocked escrow account is required, although the Investment Commission may impose capital utilization milestones on the approved investment plan.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD. RESOLVED, unanimously and with full corporate authority: (1) Share Capital Subscription. The registered share capital of the Company is hereby fixed at New Taiwan Dollars TW$4,000,000, divided into 400,000 ordinary shares of par value TW$10 each, all of which are fully subscribed and accepted by the founding shareholders. The Board approves the Share Subscription and Contribution Agreement and directs that any share premium be credited to capital surplus in accordance with the Companies Act. The paid-in capital shall be remitted in full before the statutory incorporation application is filed, and a capital verification report of a licensed certified public accountant shall be obtained promptly after deposit. (2) Banking Authorization. The Company shall maintain its principal accounts with the designated authorized foreign-exchange bank, and the Board authorizes the Chairperson, the General Manager, and any one additional statutory director, jointly with another authorized person, to open, operate, maintain, amend, and close bank accounts, to receive and endorse wire transfers, documentary collections, letters of credit, and to sign all account opening documentation, bank mandates, indemnities, and loan instruments required by the financial institution. Any two authorized representatives shall jointly execute banking instruments exceeding TW$1,000,000. (3) Registered Office. The registered office of the Company is fixed at the address stated in the Articles of Incorporation. The Board adopts this address as the legal seat of the Company, directs the Company Secretary to file the registered office with the Department of Commercial Services, and authorizes the Company Secretary to change the business correspondence address if required by the competent registry. (4) Statutory Officers. The Board elects and appoints the persons identified in the duly executed appointment consents to the offices of Chairperson and Statutory Director, General Manager, Corporate Compliance Officer, and Company Secretary. Each officer is granted the powers and duties established by the Companies Act, the Articles of Incorporation, and applicable Board resolutions, and all are authorized to execute the incorporation filing, to receive the Company Registration Certificate, and to take lawful steps to effectuate incorporation as soon as commercially practicable. (5) Corporate Seal. The Board adopts the common seal specimen shown on the signature page and authorizes its custodian to affix the seal to all formation instruments and statutory filings. (6) Indemnification and General Authority. All persons involved in the preparation of this Resolution and the incorporation are indemnified out of the Company assets against reasonable costs and liabilities. This First Board Resolution is effective immediately and may be cited as conclusive evidence of the matters resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs, R.O.C. (Taiwan), Online Business Name and Business Scope Pre-Inspection System (onestop.nat.gov.tw)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed Chinese and English company name, business scope description, responsible person identity, and intended registered address through the One-Stop Administrative Service Portal. The selected company name must not be identical with an existing Taiwan company or business name. The business scope must be drafted to cover ISIC 4669 operations, namely the wholesale of recycled scrap copper wire, non-ferrous metal scrap, and cross-border physical consignment under bonded customs procedure. No notarization is required at this pre-filing stage. The system will issue an immediate provisional result and the pre-approved name is reserved for a finite statutory period. If the proposed name is bookable, proceed to Step 2; if not, repeat with an alternate name before incurring further legal costs.
required_dossiers: Online name pre-inspection application
Proposed Chinese and English company name list with two alternates
Business scope aligned to ISIC 4669 and Taiwan customs schedule
Passport or national ID of the proposed responsible person
Power of attorney if using a licensed representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the pre-inspection is rejected for a duplicative name or a prohibited business scope, the applicant may submit a new application with a revised name or narrower scope. No formal administrative appeal is required because name pre-reservation is administrative in nature, but a corrected re-application can be made immediately to preserve the proposed incorporation timetable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Cross-Strait Investor Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, R.O.C. (Taiwan); online application through the Taiwan Invest Portal (investtaiwan.nat.gov.tw)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the standard Foreign Investment Application Form because the company is a foreign-invested limited company and the ultimate investor is a mainland Chinese enterprise. The application must describe the equity structure, beneficial ownership, source of funds, and intended business operations of CN_WFOE_LTD. Because the ownership chain is from the PRC, the matter is also assessed under the Regulations Governing the Approval of Investment by Mainland Chinese Investors. The Investment Commission will review national security, strategic industry, and public order effects, and may impose conditions such as excluding smelting or requiring a local partner. Legalized corporate documents of the parent company, audited financial statements, and a supply letter from the scrap copper wire customer are required.
required_dossiers: Completed Foreign Investment Application Form in statutory format
Mainland investor declaration and beneficial ownership register
Certificate of incorporation and audited financial statements of the PRC investor
Articles of Incorporation of the Taiwan company and business plan
Board resolution of the parent company authorizing the investment
Bank reference letter and proof of funding source
Power of attorney to local counsel or certified public accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a deficiency notice, the applicant must respond within 30 days with supplementary evidence. If the investment is disapproved, the applicant may file an administrative appeal under the Administrative Appeal Act or submit a revised application that removes restricted activities, imposes escrow conditions, or demonstrates that the capital flows are permissible under the Mainland investor approval regime.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Statutory Formation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan local district notary public or the company appointed Taiwan legal counsel; no separate government filing window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholders and proposed directors must execute the Articles of Incorporation, the Shareholder Consent, Director Appointment Consents, Registered Office Consent, and Corporate Seal Record. The Articles must contain the company name, business scope, registered capital, shareholder names and contributions, director composition, and capital contribution schedule. Because the company is a foreign-invested limited company, the Articles may be executed in bilingual Chinese and English; however, the Chinese text controls for official records. Signatures must be authenticated before a notary public where a government filing requires notarization, and all executed originals must be kept in the statutory corporate book. The consent of the owner of the registered office must be notarized or certified with valid identity. Prepare multiple duplicate originals to cover bank, customs, CPA, and licensing filings.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation signed by all shareholders
Share subscription and capital contribution schedule
Written consent of each statutory director and officer
Registered office owner consent and ownership or lease certificate
Corporate seal specimen and custodian appointment
Foreign investment approval letter from the Investment Commission
Valid identification documents of all signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notary rejects signature certification because of inconsistent documents, the applicant should execute corrected versions and resubmit. If the registry later queries articles form, the shareholders may amend by written consent and file the amended Articles simultaneously with the incorporation application to avoid delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening, Capital Remittance and CPA Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized foreign-exchange bank in Taiwan and a licensed certified public accountant registered in Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After investment approval, open a temporary capital deposit account at an authorized foreign-exchange bank in Taiwan. The foreign investor should remit the approved share capital using the Investment Commission approval letter and a permitted remittance purpose. The bank will complete foreign-exchange settlement and report to the Central Bank of the Republic of China. After full deposit, a licensed CPA must issue a capital verification report based on the bank balance certificate, remittance receipt, and approved capital schedule. No company registration filing may be made until the paid-in capital is physically deposited and verified. The CPA will confirm that no shareholder loan is substituted for equity and that no anti-money laundering or terrorism financing flags have arisen. This procedure must be documented internally and retained as the foundation of the corporate books.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Approval Letter
Bank remittance instruction and SWIFT or telegraphic transfer record
Temporary capital deposit account opening application
CPA capital verification report and audit working papers
Shareholders capital contribution schedule
Board resolution on banking representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or the central foreign exchange authority queries the remittance because the capital comes from a restricted jurisdiction, the applicant may provide the due diligence file and a legal opinion on beneficial ownership. If the bank suspends the account, submit a revised remittance instruction with a permitted payment description. If CPA verification is rejected, cure by producing the bank certificate or re-depositing the funds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Company Registration and Issuance of Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commercial Services, Ministry of Economic Affairs, R.O.C. (Taiwan), Company Registration Online System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Company Registration Application through the One-Stop portal or the physical registry office. The application must include the completed registration form, approved Articles, foreign investment approval letter, CPA capital verification report, director and officer consents, registered office consent, and the official filing fee payment. The registry will review whether the company name is valid, the business scope is within the approved foreign investment permit, the statutory officers are legally qualified, and the capital verification report is valid. An approved filing will result in the issuance of the Company Registration Certificate and notice to the National Taxation Bureau. Do not sign binding business contracts for the Taiwan entity before the certificate is obtained.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application Form signed by statutory officers
Approved Articles of Incorporation
Foreign Investment Approval Letter
CPA capital verification report
Director and officer appointment consents
Registered office consent and address proof
Company seal registration form
Official filing fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a notice of correction, the applicant must respond within 14 days with amended documents. If a substantial inconsistency affects legal rights, the applicant may file an administrative appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs. In urgent circumstances, the applicant may withdraw and re-file, preserving the corrected prepared date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Scrap Metal Dealer Registration and Customs Waste Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance, local municipal environmental protection bureau, and Customs Administration of the Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days of company registration, register the business with the National Taxation Bureau for profit-seeking enterprise income tax, business tax at 5 percent, and invoice issuance. For the physical receipt, storage, and consignment of recycled scrap copper wire, apply to the municipal environmental protection bureau for a scrap metal dealer registration under the Waste Disposal Act and obtain a non-ferrous waste import and export permit from the Ministry of Environment if the regulated material is involved. If bonded storage is planned, file a bonded warehouse license with the Customs Administration. The license description must expressly permit import, temporary storage, and re-export of shredded copper wire without smelting. Any on-site shredding or size reduction may require a stationary source operating permit under the Air Pollution Control Act.
required_dossiers: Business registration application form for the National Taxation Bureau
Company Registration Certificate and uniform invoice application
Waste Disposal Act scrap metal dealer registration form
Storage site lease, floor plan and environmental compliance declaration
Import and export waste permit application
Customs bonded warehouse application and security plan
Fire safety inspection report and insurance certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau or environmental bureau queries the operation description, provide the ISIC 4669 classification and a legal opinion proving that no smelting is performed. If permit denial is issued because the scrap is hazardous, conduct a TCLP and hazardous waste characterization and either apply for a hazardous waste treatment permit or change the supply specification to exclude contaminated copper wire.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs, R.O.C. (Taiwan), in coordination with the Ministry of Environment, Environmental Management Administration, and the local municipal environmental protection bureau.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Scrap Metal Dealer Registration Certificate under the Waste Disposal Act, Non-Ferrous Scrap Import and Export Permit, and, where on-site shredding or sorting is conducted, the Stationary Pollution Source Operating Permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, R.O.C. (Taiwan), Environmental Impact Assessment Review Committee and local municipal environmental protection authorities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Environmental Registration and Pollution Permit (no full Environmental Impact Assessment Report) if the site conducts only wholesale, handling, bonded storage, and cross-border consignment of shredded copper wire. A full EIA Report is compulsory if the project includes smelting, secondary refining, incineration, thermal treatment, or hazardous waste treatment and meets the thresholds of the EIA Act Article 4. In all cases, the operator must complete environmental registration and obtain air, water, waste, and storage permits before operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater must comply with Taiwan Effluent Standards under the Water Pollution Control Act: pH 6 to 9, chemical oxygen demand not exceeding 100 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 30 mg/L, and copper not exceeding 3 mg/L. Air emissions are limited to no more than 20 tonnes per year of volatile organic compounds without a VOCs operating permit. Particulate matter is controlled by local Air Pollution Control Act permits if shredding is added. If incoming material exhibits toxicity characteristic leaching procedure copper above 15 mg/L, or contains PCB or hydraulic oil, the material is subject to hazardous waste manifest tracking under the Waste Disposal Act and cannot be stored with non-hazardous scrap. All copper scrap storage areas must have impermeable hardstanding, a covered roof, and fluid containment to prevent soil and groundwater contamination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification under the Fire Services Act: the warehouse or storage facility must obtain a Fire Safety Equipment Inspection Certificate, maintain unobstructed egress, install automatic alarms and extinguishers, and maintain fire insurance. Structural clearance: a licensed architect or structural engineer must certify floor loading for stacked copper wire bundles and racking. Occupational safety: the Ministry of Labor, R.O.C. (Taiwan), requires a workplace hazard assessment under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, training for forklift and crane operators, personal protective equipment for copper slivers and dust, an emergency response plan, and regular worksite inspections.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA) via the electronic tax portal: https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn (Electronic Taxation Bureau, 电子税务局; however, in compliance with pure English output, the portal is referred to as the 'E-Tax Bureau Online Platform'), with local tax service branches of the provincial-level tax authorities for the registered address of the WFOE. The WFOE must also obtain a tax registration record through the 'Management Measures for Tax Registration' under the Tax Collection and Administration Law. For import/export operations, the entity must complete cross-border trade registration with the General Administration of Customs of China (GACC) and obtain the Customs Registration Code. Also register for foreign exchange current account purposes with SAFE via a designated domestic bank.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Incorporate the WFOE with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtain the Business License (营业执照). 2. Within 30 calendar days after obtaining the business license, complete the consolidated administrative registration with the competent tax authority through the 'Multi-Item Combined Registration' process, which automatically assigns the Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) equal to the Uniform Social Credit Code (USCC, 18-character code) used as the TIN. 3. Log into the E-Tax Bureau Online Platform and file the 'Information Collection for Taxpayer Registration' form, including legal representative details, ultimate beneficial ownership declaration (for AML and tax purposes), registered address, business scope, and banking account information. 4. For foreign non-resident shareholders, submit the notarized and apostilled constitutional documents of the foreign parent entity, evidence of capital contribution, and the foreign investor's certificate of incorporation; note that Taiwan-resident investors are treated specially under the Investment Approval mechanism via the Ministry of Commerce or provincial equivalents, and the non-resident shareholder must provide a Taiwan resident certificate, company registration certificate, and authorisation letter for the WFOE legal representative. 5. Submit to the tax authority the 'Accounting System and Bookkeeping Methods Filing' and 'Deposit Account Account Number Filing'. 6. Apply for qualification as a General VAT taxpayer (一般纳税人) if estimated annual taxable sales exceed the statutory threshold (currently RMB 5 million for most goods) or voluntarily, which is mandatory for engaging in export zero-rating with input VAT refund; below the threshold, the entity may be a Small-Scale VAT taxpayer. 7. Request the designation as an Export Tax Refund (Exemption) enterprise by filing the 'Export Tax Rebate (Exemption) Registration' with the tax authority after obtaining the Customs Registration Code. 8. Apply for the electronic invoice (digital Ukey) via the tax authority to issue special and ordinary VAT invoices through the 'New Generation Electronic Invoice System'. 9. Complete foreign exchange registration with SAFE through a designated bank, obtaining an 'Foreign Trade Operator Filing' and a 'Foreign Exchange Registration Certificate for Current Account'. 10. Where hazardous or environmentally-controlled scrap copper wire is involved, obtain the 'Solid Waste Import/Export License' from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) as required, since imported/exported recycled raw copper materials must comply with the 'Solid Waste Law' and the 'Announcement on Imported Solid Waste Administration'.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China operates a unified Enterprise Income Tax (EIT) system for WFOEs without a check-the-box pass-through election. The WFOE is a taxable resident enterprise at 25% EIT on worldwide income. No hybrid mismatch election is available under domestic law. However, a WFOE may elect small-scale low-profit enterprise (small low-profit enterprise) status for preferential EIT at effective rates (annual taxable income up to RMB 3 million for 2024/2025 policy window, taxed at 5% effective rate for qualifying small low-profit companies), and may elect the 'Small-Scale VAT taxpayer' simplified levy method (3% levy rate, or 1% temporary reduction where in force) instead of the General VAT taxpayer method, but such an election does not alter the entity-level taxable classification. Export zero-rating is only substantively available to General VAT taxpayers. No other statutory tax classification election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5 million (annual taxable sales of goods/services) for mandatory registration as a General VAT taxpayer; quarterly sales threshold under the small-scale VAT simplified regime is RMB 300,000 exempt from VAT (monthly RMB 100,000, with applicable policy thresholds) but registration threshold for any VAT liability is structurally unified with the business licence. In practice, any entity making taxable supplies is registered upon incorporation; however, the General/Small-Scale distinction is based on annual sales exceeding RMB 5 million.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates the use of the 'New Generation Electronic Invoicing System' (through the E-Tax Bureau Online Platform), under which VAT invoices are digitally issued with a unique electro-magnetic invoice number and encrypted stamping controlled by the STA. Full digital invoices (全面数字化电子发票) must be issued in XML/OFD format through the national e-invoice service platform, and each invoice is transmitted in near-real-time to the STA central data warehouse; there is no additional independent fiscal stamping device. The VAT Integrated Management System performs cross-automated matching of input and output invoices and enforces the 'VAT invoice segments and lines' validation with anti-fraud detection via the 'Invoice Management System' (金税四期 / Golden Tax System Phase IV). Enterprises must issue invoices via the official e-invoice APIs, and special VAT invoices must be reconciled against the STA's 'VAT Invoice Check and Comparison' platform before input tax credit is claimed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The export of goods by a General VAT taxpayer WFOE qualifies for the 0% VAT rate under the 'Measures for the Administration of the Export Tax Rebate (Exemption) of Goods' (State Administration of Taxation Announcement No. 12 of 2022 and related STA circulars) where such goods are physically exported from China and customs export declaration is completed. The recycled scrap copper wire must qualify as a genuine exportation of goods (not domestic sale), and the export proceeds must be repatriated to China. Under the 'Export Tax Refund (Exemption)' legal framework, the WFOE must: (a) hold General VAT taxpayer status; (b) have completed the export tax rebate registration; (c) possess a valid Export Customs Declaration (出口报关单) for the exact HS codes under the export contract reflecting the ISIC 4669 recycled non-ferrous scrap categories; (d) have entered into a sales contract with the Taiwan buyer, issue an export commercial invoice and packing list; (e) have physically left the territory through a designated Chinese customs port with transferable customs supervision records; (f) have received the foreign exchange payment from an overseas buyer in a recognised manner and repatriated it through the repatriation banking system within the statutory deadline. Zero-rating is available for both physical goods exports and, for qualifying offshore services, under the 'cross-border taxable services zero-rating and exemption' rules announced under Notice 2016/36 of the Ministry of Finance and STA, but the target scope for recycled scrap copper wire is a physical goods export. Note that for certain recyclable metal scrap export, there are export quota/licensing restrictions and the exporter must verify that the recycled copper wire is not classified under prohibited waste categories for export; if the shipment is treated as 'recycled copper raw materials' under the 'Management Catalogue of Solid Wastes (Import/Export)', an export licence from MEE may condition eligibility. The zero-rated export must not have been previously sold domestically or entered the VAT taxable chain in China.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Bill of Entry) - 出口货物报关单, pre-accepted and released by GACC, containing the correct HS code, weight, value, and destination (Taiwan)
Commercial Invoice and Packing List issued by the WFOE
Official Export Contract or Sale Agreement between the WFOE and Taiwan buyer
Bill of Lading (for sea freight) or Air Waybill (for air freight) evidencing physical export from China
Customs Transit/Export Release Certificate (where applicable) or electronic customs release data from the China International Trade Single Window

Inward Remittance Certificate / Export Proceeds Repatriation Certificate issued by the designated foreign-exchange bank, evidencing receipt of foreign currency (出口收汇核销单 has been replaced by the 'Export Proceeds Monitoring System' report, so the bank's 'Export Collection Confirmation' and SAFE cross-border receipts monitoring record substitute the historical FIRC)
Original VAT Invoice or special e-invoice for the exported goods (zero-rated invoice with tax rate 0%), issued via the New Generation Electronic Invoicing System
Packing certificate, quality certificate and certificate of origin (where required by Taiwan Customs for import clearance)
Export Agency Agreement (if the WFOE uses a trading agent; required only for agency export scenario)
Proof of payment of export inspection or statutory inspection certificate from the General Administration of Customs (for restricted metal scrap categories)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If the export zero-rating is claimed but the export transaction is unverified, fraudulent, or the foreign exchange is not repatriated within the statutory deadline, the tax authority will deny the zero-rated treatment, require the exporter to pay the output VAT at the standard rate (13%) on the full export value, and impose a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid VAT. For fraud involving fabricated export documents or false export declarations, the penalty ranges from 50% to 500% of the tax evaded under the Tax Collection and Administration Law; criminal prosecution under Article 204 of the Criminal Law for 'fraudulent export tax rebates' can impose imprisonment and fines where the defrauded refund exceeds RMB 50,000. Additionally, the competent tax authority may claw back any input VAT refund already paid, cancel the export tax rebate qualification for a period (from 6 months to 3 years), and publish the entity in the 'Tax Violation Blacklist' under the Joint Punishment Memorandum for Serious Tax Violations. Customs authorities may also impose administrative penalties, suspend the exporter's customs declaration qualification, and, for environmental non-compliance involving prohibited or unlicensed waste scrap exports, the MEE and customs may confiscate the goods and impose fines under the 'Solid Waste Law'.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBoC) / State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating administered foreign exchange regime with a hard separation between current-account and capital-account convertibility. On the current account, goods-trade receipts and payments, service fees, and after-tax dividend distributions can be executed through designated banks once the bank verifies authenticity through SAFE's goods-trade and non-trade surveillance platforms. The WFOE is therefore able to receive Taiwan-sourced FDI equity, pay foreign suppliers for scrap copper, and remit declared dividends, but every transaction requires an underlying contract, invoice, customs declaration or audit trail. On the capital account, however, convertibility is strictly controlled: equity injections must be pre-registered with SAFE through the PRC bank, external borrowing must meet macro-prudential limits and be registered, and any outward remittance that is not a current-account item requires prior approval. Export proceeds are not subject to mandatory conversion, but they must be repatriated to a domestic foreign-exchange account and reconciled against customs records within the statutory collection window, normally 90 days. Profit remittance to the Taiwanese shareholder is permitted under current-account rules only after payment of corporate income tax, audited financial statements confirming distributable profits, and a legal dividend declaration. Banks treat large or frequent dividends from a trading WFOE as potential disguised capital flight; therefore the treasury must retain full documentation of cumulative profits, tax payments, and actual trade operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender percentage applies to export foreign-currency receipts under current SAFE rules; 100 percent retention in a designated foreign-exchange settlement account is permitted. The statutory duty is repatriation and verification: export proceeds arising from goods export must be brought into China and reported to SAFE's trade monitoring system, typically within 90 days from the date of customs declaration unless the enterprise has obtained an approved extension. The bank matches every FX credit or conversion against the underlying customs export declaration and invoices; any shortfall, delay, or settlement mismatch triggers enhanced AML review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low and legally barred for primary settlement. Offshore fintech EMIs are not licensed by PBoC or SAFE to open domestic current-account or foreign-exchange settlement accounts for a PRC onshore WFOE. PBoC payment institution rules allow only licensed Chinese payment institutions to handle auxiliary collection and payment functions, and those licenses do not include full cross-border trade settlement, capital-account clearing, or FX conversion. The WFOE must therefore clear all inbound FDI, exports, imports, and dividend remittances through a domestic Chinese commercial bank; an offshore EMI may be used as a lightweight invoice-matching or treasury dashboard interface only if the underlying account remains at the Tier-1 PRC bank and all cash movement passes through SAFE-approved rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical branch presence is mandatory. For a new WFOE account, the legal representative and at least one statutory director or senior officer must appear in person at the PRC opening branch to complete the PBoC-mandated corporate KYC interview, signature specimen, and ultimate beneficial owner disclosure. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted by main Tier-1 banks; cross-border video interviews can be used as a supplementary control only after the physical session has been completed. If the Taiwan-based director cannot travel, the bank may allow a court- or notary-certified power of attorney, but the mainland legal representative is still expected to be physically present for the initial account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership chain across Taiwan and mainland China, especially a Taiwan corporate shareholder whose ultimate controller is not disclosed or appears to be a mainland resident, creating circular-investment and round-tripping risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Taiwan company registry and articles of incorporation; full shareholder register up to each natural-person UBO; notarized Taiwan and PRC ID or passport copies for all UBOs; board resolution authorizing the FDI; individual UBO declarations signed under penalty of law; audited financial statements for the Taiwan investor; and SAFE-recognized FDI equity injection registration form issued by the PRC bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-ferrous scrap copper commodity red flags: inconsistent pricing relative to LME or Shanghai copper indices, cash-like settlement requests, unusual supplier or consignee names, weight or grade discrepancies, or shipping routes inconsistent with circular metals trade flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master commodity purchase and sale agreements; commercial invoices; proforma invoices; third-party survey certificates from SGS, Bureau Veritas, or Intertek covering moisture, weight, grade, and radiation or non-hazardous content; packing lists; shipping records comprising bill of lading or sea waybill and container tracking; customs declarations from both Taiwan and China; supplier and end-customer KYC packs; and site inspection photographs or videos.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering or duty evasion pattern where the import or export value declared for customs does not match the FX settlement, or the same scrap copper is repeatedly shipped across borders without physical transformation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-year audited financial statements of the WFOE; monthly management accounts; VAT returns and customs duty or export tax proofs; full bank statement trail in CNY and foreign currency showing every counterparty, invoice, and FX transaction; reconciliation between customs declarations and FX remittances; independent warehouse receipts; and a logistics file demonstrating actual physical movements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or export-control hits on any party to the transaction, particularly because copper scrap can be dual-use and the Taiwan-to-mainland route creates enhanced cross-strait sensitivity under customer due diligence programmes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: World-Check, Dow Jones, OFAC SDN, and EU consolidated screening reports on all counterparties, banks, beneficiaries, consignees, and shipping agents; ultimate beneficial owner sanctions affirmations; end-user and end-use statements; export-control classification assessment confirming HS code and absence of controlled dual-use specifications; import and export licences from Taiwan Customs and PRC Customs; environmental protection or regulated-waste permit if required; and sworn compliance sign-off from the board.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan shareholder must remit FDI equity via SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's dedicated SAFE-registered foreign-exchange capital account at the Tier-1 PRC bank. The originator must use SAFE purpose code for foreign direct investment in China, commonly 622010 or the bank-mapped equivalent, and include the WFOE's FDI registration reference number in the remittance details. The PRC bank screens the remitter and checks the amount against the approved equity amount before crediting; afterwards, capital-settlement rules let the WFOE convert the foreign currency to RMB for permitted business use only. The bank will retain capital-account verification forms and the latest SAFE digital registration record, and the WFOE should obtain a bank-issued capital verification certificate or account statement for tax and audit purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For imports of shredded non-ferrous scrap copper, the primary rail is an irrevocable documentary letter of credit issued by the WFOE's PRC bank, either sight or usance with the Taiwanese seller as beneficiary; SWIFT MT103 is used for open-account settlements, repayments of trade loans, or low-value recurring consignments after approval. Documentary collections covering D/P and D/A can be used for captive supplier relationships and lower transaction values. Every outward payment must be processed through the goods-trade current account and matched to the corresponding import customs declaration, invoice, and logistics evidence in SAFE's trade monitoring system; payment terms, advance-deposit thresholds, and trade-finance limits must be approved by the bank's compliance and commodity-trade desks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: SAFE-approved onshore CNY foreign-exchange forward contracts for genuine current-account exposure, limited to outstanding trade receivables and payables and evidenced by contracts, invoices, and customs declarations.
SAFE-approved foreign-exchange swaps executed with the domestic PRC bank to repurchase or switch CNY and FX cash flows in support of the underlying trade settlement cycle.

Cross-currency swaps and interest-rate swaps only where a real capital-account liability or long-term trade-finance facility has been registered with SAFE and the notional matches the outstanding debt.

Boundary for NDFs: onshore non-deliverable forwards are not permissible for the WFOE as a direct stand-alone hedge; the use of offshore NDF or an indirect hedge through an offshore treasury vehicle requires SAFE approval and is generally reserved for multinational treasury centres, not a trading WFOE.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Information Publicity Annual Report (annual filing with the State Administration for Market Regulation, replacing the former business-license annual inspection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, local Market Supervision Administration of the WFOE's registered district
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: From 1 January to 30 June immediately following the calendar year-end; every WFOE must file its annual report by 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by 30 June triggers placement on the Abnormal Operations Directory within 10 working days; continued non-rectification for 3 consecutive years leads to inclusion in the Seriously Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprise List, targeted administrative restrictions, enhanced supervision, and potential administrative revocation of the business license after sustained non-operation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report (Foreign Investment Law and its implementing measures)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAMR together with the local Commerce Department (Ministry of Commerce) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System joint annual-report channel
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: From 1 January to 30 June following the calendar year-end; the WFOE's foreign investor information must be reported on an annual basis.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing attracts a corrective notice with statutory grace period; continuing non-compliance may result in a fine of up to RMB 500,000 and inclusion in the abnormal credit ledger, which adversely affects bank credit, foreign exchange, and cross-border trade facilitation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Income Tax Settlement Return, including related-party transaction annual reporting and transfer-pricing disclosure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA), local competent tax authority of the WFOE
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 May following the close of the fiscal year (fiscal year-end 31 December).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or underpayment triggers a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on the tax arrears, administrative fines of 50%-500% of the underpaid amount on false or evasive declarations, and enforced collection remedies; failure to submit related-party transaction forms additionally attracts specific transfer-pricing fines and an investigative adjustment risk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) annual Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) equity and registration declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through the FI/Capital Project Information System of the SAFE branch where the WFOE opens its custody account
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: From 1 January to 30 June following the calendar year-end, reflecting the prior year-end foreign equity balance.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing by 30 June places the WFOE on SAFE's abnormal-list control system; foreign-exchange transactions such as dividend remittance, cross-border capital reduction, liquidation proceeds, and settlement of working capital are suspended until the outstanding declaration and verified supporting documents are remedied.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and directors' report package (annual statutory audit report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local SAMR filing repository, the tax authority, SAFE, and relevant banking relationships; the report is retained in the WFOE's statutory records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The CPA audit must be completed and the audited financial statements approved by the WFOE's shareholders before the annual filing deadline of 30 June; the audited statements support the enterprise income tax settlement due 31 May.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain a statutory audit or to submit audited financial statements to support tax and SAFE declarations is treated as a defective annual report; the WFOE may be added to the Abnormal Operations Directory and its tax returns may be deemed inaccurate or incomplete, exposing the directors to personal liability and administrative fines.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: PRC law imposes no asset, turnover, or headcount exemption: every Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, including a small or micro WFOE, must appoint a certified public accounting firm under the PRC Company Law and Accounting Law to audit its annual financial statements. Quantitative thresholds are relevant only to the applicable accounting basis: a WFOE with annual operating revenue not exceeding RMB 30 million, total assets not exceeding RMB 50 million, and fewer than 100 employees may apply the PRC Small Business Enterprise Accounting Standards, while a WFOE exceeding these measures or falling into regulated financial, circular-economy, or cross-border trading categories must apply the full PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS); in all cases an independent CPA audit using Chinese audit standards is mandatory.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS) (converged with IFRS) for the general WFOE; PRC Small Business Enterprise Accounting Standards for eligible micro/small WFOEs; audited financial statements must reconcile with the annual enterprise income tax settlement return and the SAFE FDI equity declaration.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO return exists under PRC corporate law. The WFOE must continuously maintain beneficial-owner identification records under the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law and must update the SAMR commercial register within 30 days of any change in shareholding, ultimate beneficial owner, director, legal representative, supervisor, or registered capital. Share transfers and any adjustment to the controlling ownership structure are filed as an alteration registration with SAMR within 30 days of the resolution; the updated ownership picture is also reflected in the next annual enterprise information public filing and SAFE FDI declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Legal Representative and Senior Management
Register of Charges/Mortgages and Capital Pledges
Minutes of Shareholders' Meetings and Board Resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard PRC Enterprise Income Tax (EIT) rate
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general patent box in mainland China; available incentives include 15% High-and-New-Technology Enterprise rate, 5% effective rate for Small Low-Profit Enterprises meeting the RMB 3 million taxable-income threshold under current extension rules, 10% rates for certain encouraged software/IC enterprises, 15% Hainan Free Trade Port encouraged-business rate, and qualified income from comprehensive utilization of resources may be reduced by 10% when included in taxable income; WFOE must hold the relevant statutory license and prove operating substance to claim such incentives

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: China Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (A Class) Form A100000 and accompanying schedules, filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration E-Tax portal (etax.chinatax.gov.cn) and local tax authority systems
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual with quarterly provisional prepayments; monthly or quarterly withholding declarations for non-resident outbound dividends, interest, and royalties
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a calendar-year WFOE, quarterly EIT prepayments are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the annual EIT settlement and final return must be filed and the balance paid by May 31 of the following fiscal year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report gross sales revenue from the physical consignment of shredded recycled scrap copper wire, including export sales to Taiwan and any intercompany sales of scrap metal
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All Taiwan-related revenue must be recognized at arm's length; if title, risk, and logistics transfer inside mainland China, the full sales price is taxable to the PRC WFOE; no netting against intercompany commissions or rebates without contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report raw material procurement costs, freight, customs duties, processing, sorting, shredding, grading, and logistics costs related to recycled scrap copper
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Purchases from the Taiwan related party must be supported by genuine invoices and CUP or Cost Plus pricing; fictitious procurement invoices or inflated related-party costs will be added back and penalized

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report selling, general, administrative, and financial expenses including freight, insurance, LC discounting, Swift T/T bank charges, warehouse rent, and employee costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Service fees, management fees, and interest remitted to Taiwan must satisfy the umbrella restriction on allocation of headquarters expenses and the thin-capitalization rules; interest on excessive related-party debt is non-deductible

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report dividend income, interest income, royalties, and other non-operating investment income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Domestic-resident investment dividends are generally exempt; Taiwan-source dividends and interest received by the WFOE are taxable but foreign tax credits may be claimed under the Cross-Strait agreement upon production of tax payment vouchers

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciled accounting profit before tax per the PRC GAAP financial statements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify that all documentary LC and Swift T/T settlements are recorded in revenue; untraceable offshore receipts are a major audit and criminal-red-flag trigger

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile accounting profit to taxable income by adding back non-deductible expenditure and reducing tax-exempt or adjustable items
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back transfer pricing adjustments, excessive related-party interest, non-compliant invoice expenses, entertainment over-limits, and penalties; reverse any fabrication of deductions tied to scrap-supply chains

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset qualified prior-year tax losses against current-year taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses are limited to five carryforward years and must match previously filed returns; losses from any Taiwan branch cannot be used to offset mainland China profits unless validly recognized in the annual tax reconciliation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after tax adjustments and loss carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure no deferred revenue from intercompany scrap consignments is hidden; taxable income must not be reduced by artificial related-party service fees from Taiwan shell entities

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 / Line 9: Tax Payable at Statutory Rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 25% EIT rate to taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If claiming the 15% High-New-Tech rate, the WFOE must hold a valid certificate; recycled scrap trading ordinarily remains at 25% absent a qualifying technological transformation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 / Line 10: Foreign Tax Credit and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claim foreign tax credits for tax already paid outside China, withholding tax credits, equipment investment credits, and other statutory credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For Taiwan-source income, credits require a Taiwan Tax Residency Certificate, tax payment vouchers, and evidence that the income was actually subject to tax in Taiwan; duplicate credits denied

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report tax exemptions, reduced rates, resource comprehensive utilization income, and qualified technology or infrastructure incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Scrap copper resource-utilization benefits require inclusion in the permitted catalog, a statutory license, and separate accounting; failure to prove environmental compliance voids the incentive

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 12 / Line 12: Net Tax Due or Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final EIT liability after quarterly prepayments, refunds, and non-resident withholding obligations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Before declaring dividends to the Taiwan shareholder, settle all outstanding EIT and withholding tax; the WFOE must withhold 10% domestic WHT or a reduced 5% under the Cross-Strait agreement, remit it, and file the related non-resident declaration

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fine of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 per return, and RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000 in serious cases; late payment accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue tax; false or fraudulent under-declaration is penalized at 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax and may constitute criminal tax evasion under PRC Criminal Law Article 201, carrying imprisonment and property confiscation; the legal representative may be placed on a tax blacklist and prohibited from leaving China pending payment
